decisions.reason: As a core door lever handle family in the firm's main specification business, it supports continuity for architects and installers and is likely to be retained.
The mitred door lever handle family reinforces the firm's design-led architectural portfolio, so withdrawal is unlikely unless demand has clearly disappointed.
This door lever handle line remains close to the firm's established strengths and helps cover different design preferences within coordinated hardware ranges.
The door and window handle collection appears to be a flagship family with its own page and an award-winning model, making it very unlikely to be discontinued.
A surface finish is easier to rationalize than a full hardware family, but this light patinated bronze option still fits the firm's premium architecture-focused offering and should remain available.
